notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence. Not in the corpus: Lighthouse Board reports 1902-1909 (construction), so construction details rest on Lighthouse Friends and Pepper (copyrighted, paraphrased). Sources disagree on the appropriation date (LHF 3 March 1903; Pepper 3 March 1902; Wikipedia 1902), tower height (76 ft vs 70/80 ft vs 71 ft), and electrification/diaphone (Pepper: by 1928; LHF: diaphone 1931, electric 1938); all stated as disagreements in the story. The NRHP nomination is not digitised. USLHS roster matched by name only (its coordinates are 4417 km off), place page is the right light by region. The 1918 Bulletin OCR is poor: 'Crooked Island' and 'yacht Companion' read from OCR; the bay name is unreadable and was omitted; please check the page image. Oscar J. Louks (1st assistant, per Bulletin 1918 and its index) is not on the USLHS roster, which has Hassett as first assistant to 1919. The 1916 Commissioner table (p. 60) is OCR columns; the Irvington link to the three keepers rests on Lighthouse Friends, the report only lists both names near each other. The 1881 Life-Saving Station is a separate record possibly; not researched. Ownership today uncertain: 2021 sale offering and Dec 2024 listing of island; current owner not verified. Roster 'Hubert Rhodes (at least 1952-)' given as 1952 approx. Verifier 2026-10-27: NPGallery 'Date Published 3/15/2006' is the asset record date, not necessarily the listing date; story reworded. Tower painted white/black band: Pepper 1939 vs LHF 1953. Oil house: LHF 1905 vs Pepper 1906. Louks' yacht Companion is in the 1918 Bulletin OCR (Thunder Bay, Mich.).
